sections.label: The opening
sections.line: Lovable's agent can change production; its controls are real, its defaults open, and the policy records what each project's agent may do.
sections.para: From Lovable's docs: Build mode applies changes directly, the agent can change the live database, auth and connected systems, and publish. Controls include per-action permissions, Plan mode, migration approval, scans, publish blocks, workspace policies, a pre-prompt hook and audit logs, and Lovable holds AIUC-1. Nine of ten backend permissions default to Always allow, set per user. The policy sets which go to Ask each time, per project.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Production reach, real controls, open defaults, a platform certificate, the policy per project.
sections.para: Six points; nothing run on Lovable yet.

sections.label: Why Lovable
sections.line: A builder for non-engineers, which makes defaults matter more.
sections.para: Raised $400 million at a $13.3 billion valuation in August; two earlier newsroom pieces.

sections.label: What Lovable's agent can reach
sections.line: Three modes, long goals, Lovable Cloud on the live database, connectors, secrets, testing and publishing.
sections.para: Shared connectors mirror the connected account.

sections.label: The defaults
sections.line: Nine of ten backend permissions default to Always allow, including changing data and auth.
sections.para: Breaking migrations default to Never; settings are per user across every workspace.

sections.label: The controls, and what they leave open
sections.line: Plan mode, connector approvals, scans, publish block, workspace policies, secrets, hook and audit logs, each with its gap.
sections.para: The publish block is off by default outside Enterprise; the hook and logs see prompts, not actions.

sections.label: The platform is certified; the project is not
sections.line: AIUC-1 covers the platform; the project still needs its own record.
sections.para: Lovable's April 2026 incident and two-hour fix show both levels are needed.
